messages:
dimitri: Quick follow-up on pin schema: we need to lock down telemetry fields + precedence so ops + UX can correlate incidents. Posting short proposal.

sarah: Thanks. What telemetry fields are you proposing?

dimitri: Minimal set: pin_ref, pin_origin, chosen_artifact_hash, requested_fingerprint (if any), fallback_reason (if any), resolution_latency_ms, lineage_distance. Keep keys short.

morgan: +1. Also include pin_policy in telemetry (strict/prefer/legacy) so we can filter by enforcement mode.

oliver: Precedence needs to be explicit in docs. Proposed: request_pin (highest), route_pin, tenant_pin, org_pin, global_default. If request_pin exists and policy==strict => reject on mismatch.

chris: For strict rejects, what's the client contract? 409 with structured body and hint?
dimitri: Yes. 409 payload: error_code: PIN_MISMATCH, expected_fingerprint, actual_candidate_hashes (short list), human_message. Clients can surface as modal.

sarah: How do we minimize payload size at high QPS? We shouldn't return long arrays. Suggest limit candidate hashes to 3 and short hex.
morgan: Agree. Also, runtime should emit a compact pin_resolution event to our metrics pipeline; full audit logs go to blob store asynchronously.

oliver: Migration question: legacy pins without fingerprint should be treated as prefer/legacy. Emit admin alert listing pins that couldn't be fingerprinted.

chris: UI: add a small "pin provenance" popover: shows alias, fingerprint (if present), origin, and a short "last verified" timestamp. Keep it compact.

dimitri: One more: add pin_ttl semantics for sticky/ephemeral pins. Field `ttl_seconds` optional. If present runtime decrements and expires. Telemetry should include remaining_ttl on resolution events.

sarah: Edge case: tenant-level override of route pin. Should tenant override beat route? I think route should be stronger because routes are explicit product intents.
morgan: Route should win over tenant by default. We'll document precedence as request > route > tenant > org > global and allow an opt-in `tenant_force` flag for customers with special needs.

schema-bot: Schema change proposal created: schemas/pin_v2.proto (draft). CI: pin-telemetry-tests queued.
dimitri: Action items: I'll open RFC with exact telemetry schema + error payloads. Morgan/Oliver will prototype routing precedence enforcement. Sarah/Chris will mock UI changes. No blockers, will ship draft today.

morgan: LGTM.

oliver: +1.

chris: 👍
